lines.text: You crossed that sea to bring me a letter. Tell me why I should open it.
Because he asked me to bring it home. I didn't know the keeper was his mother.
Captain, the lantern's fading. There's a boat beyond the rocks. It can't see us.
He used to count the waves while I lit the lamp. I haven't heard him in years.
Then you read. I'll hold the light. Pim, count with me. One. Two.
Three. Four. Captain, look. She's turning toward the harbour.
